description: (Na)₂CrAuF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a CrAuF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the CrAuF₆ framework, Cr is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AuF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cr-F bond lengths are 1.90 Å. Au is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AuF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Au-F bond lengths are 2.36 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Cr and one Au atom.
